messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty SEV2 — elevated 5xx rate on inference-gateway (prod, us-west). Alerting team. Suspected: route/retry config causing amplification. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/alerts/3380001234
Sarah Chen: seeing 5xx spike ~03:14 UTC, error code 503 and some 504 timeouts. No model deploys in the last hour.
Priya Raman: we rolled a canary for "legacy-embedder" earlier today (~10% traffic). It included a header-based split. Didn’t touch retry policy intentionally.
Evan Kline: looking at envoy admin config_dump — the virtual host for legacy-service has a retry_policy configured with `num_retries: 10` and `retry_on: 5xx`. That’s... aggressive. Could be amplifying backend errors into more load.
Sarah Chen: @Infra Eng did your routing tweak include any control-plane changes that could've bumped retry config?
Infra Eng: I only added the header match rule for canary split. I didn't change retry policy in the control-plane files, but control-plane service did push a full config sync at ~03:10 UTC. Pulling the full config now.
Mike O'Neil: I'm oncall, taking this. Acknowledge. @incident-bot please escalate to paging rules. How many customers impacted and region scope?
customer-success-bot: Telemetry: approx 15% of API calls in us-west saw 5xx over the last 10m. Top affected customers: AcmeCorp, BetaBooks. CS is pinging them now. No PII exposures reported.
Mike O'Neil: Priority mitigation: 1) disable retry amplification at edge (set num_retries=0 or remove retry_policy) 2) rollback canary weight to 0% for legacy-embedder route 3) scale backend replicas/raise circuit breaker thresholds temporarily. Proceeding with step 1.
Priya Raman: Found the control-plane patch that introduced the retry section — it was inherited from an older profile. Here's the offending snippet from config_dump:
```yaml
virtual_hosts:
  - name: legacy-service
    routes:
      - match:
          prefix: "/v1/legacy"
        route:
          cluster: legacy-upstream
          retry_policy:
            retry_on: "5xx"
            num_retries: 10
```
Mike O'Neil: That `num_retries: 10` is the culprit — retries are amplifying transient 5xx into sustained load. We'll disable retries for that virtual host.
Sarah Chen: How are we applying the change? Do we have a control-plane patch or direct configmap?
Priya Raman: We can patch the control-plane configmap and push. Using `kubectl apply -f -` to avoid manual edits.
Priya Raman: Running:
```bash
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: envoy-route-legacy
  namespace: infra
data:
  config.yaml: |
    route:
      retry_policy:
        num_retries: 0
EOF
```
Infra Eng: Received patch, applying to control-plane. Pushing xDS update to Envoys now.
Mike O'Neil: After patch, doing rolling restart of edge proxies in us-west to pick up immediate change (we'll try xDS first, fallback to restart if needed).
Mike O'Neil: Exec: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart daemonset/envoy-proxy-us-west`
Infra Eng: Restart started. Watching healthchecks.
incident-bot: Update: retries disabled for legacy virtual_host, rollout restart initiated.
Evan Kline: Watching metrics — within ~6 minutes post-change, 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 3% in us-west. Latencies also trending down. Looks like retry amplification and consequent circuit-breaker cascade were the core issue.
Nia Patel: I also bumped the legacy service healthcheck timeout from 1s -> 2s to reduce flapping; backend was flapping under spike and envoy was marking endpoints unhealthy quickly.
Priya Raman: Rolling rollback of canary weight to 0% completed via control plane console. Canary removed.
Mike O'Neil: Customer impact window estimated ~03:12–03:24 UTC (~12 minutes). CS confirmed notifications sent to affected customers.
Sarah Chen: Actions for postmortem: 1) tighten default retry_profile (no 5xx retries by default) — Evan to own. 2) Add a pre-deploy smoke test that simulates backend 5xx to detect amplification risk — Priya to own. 3) Add alerting for retry-amplification pattern (retries increase followed by upstream 5xx spike) — Infra Eng to own. 4) Add gating that prevents accidental inheritance of legacy retry blocks on new routes.
Evan Kline: I’ll own the default retry_profile change and coordinate with runtime team for rollout.
Priya Raman: I’ll add the smoke test into the canary pipeline and add a preflight check to the control-plane deploy.
Mike O'Neil: I'll draft the incident timeline and file the postmortem. Assigning Sev owner for write-up.
Sarah Chen: Any follow-ups to do before we close this thread?
Infra Eng: I'll run a quick audit across all virtual hosts to find any other routes with `num_retries > 3` and create PR to normalize profiles.
Nia Patel: Re-running load test for legacy path to validate stability after changes.
customer-success-bot: CS follow-up: AcmeCorp escalated to Tier1; they accepted mitigation notes and ETA for postmortem.
Mike O'Neil: Great work everyone. Concluding live mitigation. Converting notes into postmortem ticket: INC-2026-3380001234. Will ping owners for follow-ups. :white_check_mark: 
Sarah Chen: +1 on postmortem. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
Evan Kline: Found one other route with `num_retries: 8` — adding to PR.
Mike O'Neil: Closing thread, move further discussion to the incident doc.
